mapper.insert: insert into score ( score_no, student_no, score_type, score_name, score_subject, score_score, score_rank, score_date ) values ( score_seq.nextval, #{studentNo}, #{scoreType}, #{scoreName}, #{scoreSubject}, #{scoreScore}, #{scoreRank}, #{scoreDate} )
mapper.select: select score_no as scoreNo, student_no as studentNo, score_type as scoreType, score_name as scoreName, score_subject as scoreSubject, score_score as scoreScore, score_rank as scoreRank, score_date as scoreDate, score_wtime as scoreWtime from score where score_no = #{scoreNo}

select score_no as scoreNo, student_no as studentNo, score_type as scoreType, score_name as scoreName, score_subject as scoreSubject, score_score as scoreScore, score_rank as scoreRank, score_date as scoreDate, score_wtime as scoreWtime from score where student_no = #{studentNo} order by score_date desc
mapper.update: update score set score_type = #{scoreType}, score_name = #{scoreName}, score_subject = #{scoreSubject}, score_score = #{scoreScore}, score_rank = #{scoreRank}, score_date = #{scoreDate} where score_no = #{scoreNo}
mapper.select: select score_subject as scoreSubject, score_score as scoreScore, score_rank as scoreRank, -- 이전 시험 등급을 가져와서 현재 등급과 빼기 (낮아질수록 좋은 거라면 순서를 바꿔도 됨) score_rank - lag(score_rank, 1) over (partition by score_subject order by score_date asc) as rankDiff from score where student_no = #{studentNo} and score_name = #{scoreName} /* ex: '1학기 중간고사' */ and score_type = '내신' order by case when score_subject like '%국어%' or score_subject in ('문학', '독서', '화법과 작문', '언어와 매체') then 1 when score_subject like '%수학%' or score_subject in ('미적분', '기하', '확률과 통계') then 2 when score_subject like '%영어%' then 3 when score_subject like '%사회%' or score_subject like '%과학%' or score_subject like '%탐구%' then 4 when score_subject like '%한국사%' or score_subject like '%역사%' then 5 else 6 end asc, score_subject asc

select sc.score_subject as scoreSubject, sc.score_score as scoreScore, sc.score_rank as scoreRank, sc.score_rank - lag(sc.score_rank, 1) over (partition by sc.score_subject order by sc.score_date asc) as rankDiff from score sc -- 과목명이 똑같은 것을 기준으로 조인 (left outer join으로 혹시 매칭 안 되는 과목도 성적은 나오게 방어) left outer join subject sb on sc.score_subject = sb.subject_name where sc.student_no = #{studentNo} and sc.score_name = #{scoreName} /* ex: '3월 모의고사' */ and sc.score_type = '모의고사' or '수능' order by sb.subject_code asc nulls last -- 과목 코드가 낮은 순(국->수->영...)으로 정렬, 매칭 안 된 건 맨 뒤로
select score_name as scoreName, score_type as scoreType from score where student_no = #{studentNo} group by score_name, score_type order by max(score_date) desc
